oPt: WHO Director-General Dr Tedros Adhanom Ghebreyesus on the attack on health care in Gaza
articles.description: Another deadly attack on health care in Gaza: in the early morning hours, the surgery department of Nasser Medical Complex was hit, resulting in six deaths -- including a health worker, patients and companions, and injuring at least 27 others. The department is reported to be extensively damaged. Other hospital floors were also reportedly affected, including the surgical theatres, recovery unit and intensive care unit. Assessment of the full impact is ongoing. Since October 2023, WHO has documented 1056 attacks on health care in Gaza, resulting in 1010 deaths and 1725 injuries. Health needs remain immense in Gaza and will only grow as winter sets in. Rain, flooding and the cold will worsen living conditions and raise the risk of disease amidst the crippled water and sanitation systems. Our call remains unchanged: allow unhindered humanitarian access and let more medical and humanitarian supplies enter Gaza. Gaza’s health facilities are lifelines for its people. They must be protected. They must never be militarized or attacked. The best medicine is peace.
